description: Random pixel dropout plus thick border cut-outs (4–24 px), like after a fast head turn. The net learns to regenerate.

status.comment: Border regeneration: already covered by train.turn (head-turn augmentation opens thick borders). Dropout: new train.dropout (train.py knock_out): per step, smooth-noise blobs (~8 px at data.size) covering up to that fraction of each sample are zeroed in the resolved state and count as holes (hole_weight) in the loss. Verified: unit check (zeroed pixels == hole mask, per-sample fractions 0.07..0.39 at 0.5), 3-iteration end-to-end run with dropout 0.3 completed (val printed). Not yet: a real run comparing with/without dropout (CPU busy with deep24, ~6 h).
